scope: Local GNU/Linux CLI with reversible marking, integrity verification, heuristic comparison, GPG and OpenSSH Ed25519 signing.

environment.execution: user/mount/network/PID namespaces; read-only project/toolchain; clean environment; fixture-only keys

review.type: focused source review with a separate reviewer

release_gate: Before publication, the annotated v0.3.0 tag must match main and the genuine unencrypted ZUPT archive must pass integrity testing and extracted-byte comparison with the tagged source.
limitations: Windows CI results are separate from this local record.
This is a focused review, with no claim of an external certification or comprehensive penetration test.
Heuristic similarity, removable marks and signatures do not establish legal authorship or a trusted timestamp.
Actively hostile concurrent modification and crash recovery after forced termination remain outside the supported guarantee.
